summary: Russell hunts redemption despite a grid penalty, with Ferrari's Leclerc capitalizing on Mercedes' misfortune after dominating Friday practice in the sweltering Marina Bay circuit. McLaren's consistency and Bottas's underdog Cadillac charge will test whether penalty-hit Russell can still deliver from the back, adding chaos to an already unpredictable night race. A strong result here could reshape the title fight with just nine races remaining, making this the final sprint weekend a potential watershed moment in the championship battle.
